R467.note: Placeholder plus [userId] values array is the correct mysql2 parameterization; nothing else changed.

R470.note: Deriving the stored extension from the MIME allowlist closes the dangerous-extension write, but the added originalname extension allowlist now rejects extension-less uploads (e.g. blob/canvas 'photo') that the original accepted with a valid image MIME type.
